title: 2024 law protecting ICIG whistleblowers who disclose CIA and DOE secrets
summary: Dylan Borland tells of 2024 law protecting ICIG whistleblowers who disclose CIA and DOE secrets, about 2024 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: whistleblowers going to the ICIG, uh, if they disclose CIA secrets and Department of Energy secrets, they're not allowed to be prosecuted for espionage."

plain: Dylan Borland, a whistleblower who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, describes a 2024 law. He says that under it, people who bring secrets about the CIA or the Department of Energy, the agency that runs America's nuclear weapons work, to the ICIG, the internal watchdog office for US spy agencies, cannot be prosecuted for espionage. If so, it would give insiders a safe way to report hidden programmes.
